title: Espresso profiles
changes: Choose Drip or Espresso when you create a profile, next to your roaster. Neither can be changed later.
For espresso, the profile wizard sets a longer target development time, since espresso usually develops longer than filter. These are estimates for every roaster, the SR800 included.
Each profile shows its style next to its roaster in the profile lists and on Add Roast, and each roast records its profile's style.
Existing profiles and roasts are Drip.

title: Version number and What's new
changes: The current version now shows in the footer of every page.
This What's new page lists what changed in each version.

title: Works on your phone
changes: Pages now fit a phone screen instead of shrinking down to a tiny desktop page.
On Add Roast, the timer, chart and First Crack Now! button come first, above the form.
Bigger buttons and fields, number pads for weights and temperatures, and taller charts.

title: Choose your roaster
changes: Pick your roaster first when you make a profile. The profile then follows it: the number of temperature rows, the weight and time limits, and Fahrenheit or Celsius.
46 roasters to choose from. Your roaster is shown in the roast list and the CSV export.
The chart and the profile wizard follow your roaster. Only the Fresh Roast SR800 is calibrated; for the others the wizard says its values are estimates.
Optional start condition (cold, warm or preheated) and ambient temperature for each roast.
Existing profiles and roasts were assigned to the Fresh Roast SR800.

title: Pull countdown
changes: After you mark first crack, a live countdown shows when to pull the roast.
The profile wizard now fills in target first-crack and development times instead of a temperature curve after first crack.
Wizard pacing was recalibrated for Fresh Roast machines.

title: Crackle, with roast insights
changes: Renamed Crackle, with an About page and a feedback form.
Each roast shows weight loss, roast level, development time and development ratio. Search and sort the roast list, and export it to CSV.
A First Crack Now! button, bean origin, variety and process, and cupping notes with a rating.
A profile wizard that suggests a starting profile from a few questions.
Pick a profile from a card grid with your favorites on top.

title: Accounts and a live timer
changes: A live roast timer and target-temperature graph on Add Roast.
Favorite profiles, and a warmer new look.
Accounts: your roasts and profiles are private to you, with password reset and email verification.

title: First version
changes: See your roasts in a table, with a temperature chart for each roast.
Add a roast with a temperature entry for every minute.
Create, edit and delete roast profiles and roasts, from a main menu.
